translation: From ancient times good physicians have not been lacking in each generation; truly they could raise the dead and restore life, truly entering the spirit and leaving the transformation. Yet they left their names for a thousand ages while their heart-methods were not transmitted, leaving only medical cases and formulas, so that later people had nothing to follow. The present Way is like a great road: everyone can do it, and at any time it can be practiced. One only worries that people do not seek it, not that the method is not transmitted. The collected sayings being complete, I place the Discourse on Rubbing Accumulation at the head, and wish that it be read first.
